name: MAGMA Puro Migration
description: Migrate Donkey from the current md+magma hybrid memory runtime to a MAGMA-first architecture, keeping Markdown as export/debug and moving retrieval closer to the MAGMA paper.

userStories.title: Add MAGMA stats API for real memory counts
userStories.description: As an operator, I want MAGMA to expose counts for nodes, embeddings, and edges so that status and diagnostics reflect the real backend rather than file heuristics.
acceptanceCriteria: Add graph-level stats proc(s) in src/donkey/adapters/memory/magma_graph.nim for memory, user_profile, preference, entity, embedding, and edge counts
Add adapter-level wrapper(s) in src/donkey/adapters/memory/magma_memory_adapter.nim so runtime code does not query SQL directly
Cover the stats API with PostgreSQL-backed tests

userStories.title: Expose MAGMA counts in /status and /api/status
userStories.description: As an operator, I want /status and the HTTP status payload to report MAGMA counts so I can verify how much memory is actually stored.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend src/donkey/ports/ipc.nim so DaemonStatus can carry MAGMA stats when PostgreSQL memory is enabled
Populate those fields from the daemon status builder in src/donkey.nim
Update ctl status and /api/status output to show MAGMA node and embedding counts
Add or update tests covering status serialization and user-visible output

userStories.title: Expose MAGMA counts in /doctor
userStories.description: As an operator, I want /doctor to report graph-backed memory stats so diagnostics stop relying on paddock file counts.
acceptanceCriteria: Update buildDoctorReport in src/donkey/adapters/channel/common_runtime.nim to show MAGMA node and embedding counts as the primary memory signal
Keep paddock path and file count only as secondary debug information when relevant
Add or update tests for doctor output text

userStories.title: Make /memory read from MAGMA
userStories.description: As a user, I want /memory to show the graph-backed memory view so the command reflects what retrieval actually uses.
acceptanceCriteria: Update channel /memory handlers to load reconstructed memory from MAGMA when PostgreSQL memory is enabled
Preserve the existing Markdown-only behavior as fallback when MAGMA is disabled
If both views are shown, label the MAGMA-derived snapshot clearly so it is not confused with raw MEMORY.md
Add or update channel command tests for the new behavior

userStories.title: Switch conversation context loading to MAGMA-first
userStories.description: As a developer, I want normal conversation context to load from MAGMA first so the graph becomes the effective source of truth during runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Update the context loading path so profile, preferences, and memory are loaded from MAGMA first when PostgreSQL memory is enabled
Use Markdown import only as bootstrap when the graph is empty for a user
Keep preference-dependent behaviors such as rerank resolution working under the MAGMA-first flow
Add regression coverage for bootstrap import and MAGMA-first context loading

userStories.title: Demote Markdown to export and debug mode
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want Markdown files to become derived export/debug artifacts instead of the authoritative memory backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Change the PostgreSQL-enabled runtime path so MAGMA is the authoritative write target for user profile, preferences, and memories
Keep or extend explicit export commands so USER.md, MEMORY.md, and PREFERENCES.md can still be generated from MAGMA for inspection
Document clearly in README.md and TODO.md that Markdown is no longer the source of truth when MAGMA is enabled
Keep the no-Postgres fallback path working for environments without MAGMA

userStories.title: Materialize causal edges on the write path
userStories.description: As a system, I want new memories to create real causal edges so MAGMA covers more of the paper than semantic, temporal, and entity links alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement causal extraction or inference in the MAGMA write path for appendMemory and related persistence flows
Persist CAUSAL edges in magma_edges for representative cause/effect inputs
Add PostgreSQL-backed tests showing causal edges are created and linked to the right memory nodes

userStories.title: Use causal signals in retrieval scoring
userStories.description: As a user, I want causal questions to retrieve cause/effect memories so MAGMA behaves more like the paper on why/led-to/because queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend search scoring or traversal in src/donkey/adapters/memory/magma_memory_adapter.nim to consider causal neighbors
Teach query policy classification to recognize causal intent in addition to semantic, temporal, and entity intent
Add tests showing causal queries surface the correct memories and score breakdowns

userStories.title: Tighten retrieval policy toward the MAGMA paper
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the retrieval policy to move beyond the current heuristic blend so the implementation aligns better with the paper's structured query-adaptive retrieval.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor query policy and retrieval scoring so semantic, entity, temporal, and causal signals are represented explicitly and coherently
Keep reranking compatible with the richer score breakdown rather than bypassing it
Add regression tests covering semantic, entity, temporal, and causal query classes
